about: Plain-language summary of battery v4, read by https://1fab0.com. Every count is generated from results/verdicts-v4-summary.json (quire's run, commit 0587d7d in thechrisroberts/fly-battery); only the wording is written by hand.
run: Battery v4: 30 trials for the real wiring, 30 for the scrambled wiring, and 30 for the random-settings fake at each of 5 loudness levels (1,260 simulated trials in all, 3,150 stimulus runs).

items.plain: Signals to walk away from CO2
items.label: Passes
items.note: Clearly beats both fakes at all five loudness levels.
items.name: CO2 avoidance, walking state

items.plain: Steering signals reverse when the scenery reverses
items.label: Passes
items.note: The clearest result: the fakes almost never do it. This test was rewritten for this version, because as first written half of it could not pass.
items.name: optomotor turning

items.plain: Escape neuron fires for a looming object
items.label: Passes at 4 of 5 levels (not at the quietest)
items.note: At the quietest setting the random-settings fake escaped too (24 of 30), because the looming-detector neurons connect almost directly to the escape neuron, so random settings produce it when activity is low. It clearly beats the fakes at the other four levels.
items.name: looming escape via the giant fibre

items.plain: Prefers a good smell to a bad one
items.label: Fails
items.note: The model shows the preference in 5 of 30 trials, the same as the scrambled wiring.
items.name: odour valence ordering

items.plain: A good smell attracts less when it is too strong
items.label: Fails
items.note: The model shows it in 1 of 30 trials. The fakes show it more often (8 to 15 of 30).
items.name: concentration reversal

items.plain: Male courtship neurons switch on at a female's taste, not a male's scent
items.label: Fails
items.name: male courtship song pathway
